uuid.description: A canonical identifier: a version 4 UUID in lower case. Permanent and never reused.

revision.description: Counts changes to the object's content. A review summary names the revision it judged.

languageTag.description: A BCP 47 language tag, such as en, af, zu or pt-BR.

langString.description: Authored text keyed by BCP 47 language tag, as a JSON-LD language map: {"en": "Subtract integers"}. Official text is never stored this way: a statement quotes one document, in that document's language.

officialText.description: Text copied word for word from an official document, in the document's language.

code.description: A human-readable label. It may gain aliases but never changes meaning; the UUID is the identity.

status.description: Review status of an interpretation object or link. Only confirmed objects and links reach a public release.

objectKind.description: Every kind of object a base publishes.

count.description: How many objects the file holds.
